target_customer: Canadian shoppers using the free app; retailers and brands who pay for flyer distribution and advertising
problem: Printed retail flyers were wasteful and hard to browse or measure; shoppers wanted to browse flyers on a phone and retailers wanted measurable reach.
business_model: free consumer app monetized by retailer and brand flyer distribution and advertising
product_category: digital flyer and grocery list app

founders.name: Michal Martyniak
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder by BetaKit (2022-06); a Waterloo alumni piece says two Waterloo students created reebee in 2012, with Velocity Fund support.

founders.name: Tobiasz Dankiewicz
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him; exited in 2022.

competitors.name: Flipp
competitors.what: Digital flyer app, created 2007 by former Microsoft engineers and launched on iOS in 2013

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile app plus flyer ingestion and distribution; effort was in retailer data pipelines.

defensibility.rationale: Retailer relationships help, but Flipp offered the same content to the same shoppers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Flipp acquired its largest rival reebee in June 2022.

market_need_then: Retail flyers in Canada were still largely print in 2012 to 2013; mobile usage was growing.

brand_strength.rationale: Second largest flyer channel in Canada, but no source shows brand pull; the branding search returned nothing about reebee.

outcome_analysis: Reebee became Canada's second largest digital flyer channel, claiming over 2 million monthly users and about 80 employees by 2022, but its rival Flipp was larger. After a small Waterloo grant, YC in 2013 and a 2019 strategic investment from RHI Group, it was acquired by Flipp in June 2022 and kept its brand and Kitchener office.
notes: Directory status says Active but Flipp acquired it in 2022; it operates as a subsidiary. Flipp's corporate page says July 2023 while the help center and BetaKit say June 2022; June 2022 used. CB Insights shows $20K over 4 rounds, unverified. The Flipp competitor source is an undated Canadian Grocer piece seen only in a search snippet describing 2012 to 2013 conditions. Branding search returned nothing relevant. Education is inferred from the Waterloo alumni snippet, which says two Waterloo students created reebee, not by name.
